I made a block diagram for the PCB. The software was unusual and I am sure I made a lot of not optimal arrows, due to this I had to improvise a lot and stack arrows on each other or make a stray arrow of the right shape and adjust its length and generally most of the time went on checking if the connections made sense/ trying to wire everything. The question marks are requirements of each part which I looked up in the respected documentations which took a bit of time especially the esp32-s3 wroom-1.
